name: IG3254COD UV COD and TOC Sensor
shortDescription: Ultraviolet absorption supports online COD and TOC measurement without reagent dosing. Turbidity compensation, calibration options and an available automatic cleaning system help adapt the digital probe to water monitoring, with results interpreted according to the selected calibration.
bodyHtml:
Product features:
◆ Digital sensor, 485 output, supports Modbus RTU
◆ No need for reagents, no pollution, more economical and environmentally friendly
◆ Optional automatic cleaning device can effectively remove surface contamination of sensors, prevent microbial growth, and achieve more accurate and lower maintenance
◆ Measurable SAC COD、TOC、 Turbidity, temperature and other parameters
◆ Automatically compensates for turbidity and suspended solids interference, with excellent testing performance
Application areas:
Municipal sewage, industrial wastewater, environmental monitoring, monitoring of drinking and surface water, industrial processes, aquaculture, biological processes
Technical parameters:
Range: COD (calibrated using KHP): 0~500mg/L，0-1500 mg/L COD 
TOC (calibrated using KHP): 0~180mg/L TOC ，0~600 mg/L TOC
Measurement principle: 254nm ultraviolet absorption spectrum
Light source: flashing xenon lamp
Optical path length: 2.5mm, 6.5mm
Measurement accuracy: ± 5% of the reading
Repeatability: less than ± 5%
Detection limit: 0.1 mg/L
Measurement intervals: 15s, 30s, 1min, 30min
Calibration methods: single point sample calibration, multi-point standard solution calibration, slope calibration
Sensor material: Body: SUS316L； Window: Sapphire
Self cleaning: automatic scraping brush
Cross sensitivity compensation: turbidity
Sensor communication: MODBUS RS-485 
Storage temperature:- 10~50℃ 
Working temperature: 0~50 ℃ (non freezing)
Protection level: IP68 
Cable length: Standard 10m, extendable
Sensor size: 179mm*50mm
